title: Amazingly Sweet Russian Beet Borscht
description: A sweet and comforting Russian soup featuring beets and onion salt, perfect for a sick day. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly dish is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: In a large pot, bring the vegetable broth to a boil.
Add the grated beets, carrots, and celery to the pot and blanch for 5 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the onion salt and lemon juice.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Strain the soup through a fine-mesh sieve to remove any solids.
Serve the soup hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of chopped dill if desired.
Let the soup cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until chilled.
Once chilled, the soup will have a glassy-jelly texture.
Serve the soup cold, garnished with additional chopped dill if desired.
